Local by design,controlled by you Work history and knowledge stays local by default.External processing only happens when configured,so your data boundaries remain clear and controlled. Traceable evidence,trusted conclusions Every insight is linked to its source,from literature snippets to the final report,with a complete and traceable reasoning path. Domain intelligence,built for expert work Domain experts continuously refine data, models,and workflows, so every analysis meets industry standards—not generic model output. Expandable with MCPs and Skills Turn expert workflows into Skillsand connect systems through MCPs,so capabilities keep expanding with your needs. Testimony from users Feedback from real work scenarios First-hand user experience from the IP, R&D, and technical intelligence teams. Before, novelty searches meant constantly jumping between patent full texts, web sources, and my own notes. Now I can keep working around the same task, with the key evidence always easy to revisit. Engineer Patent Engineer · Patent Search and Novelty Assessment When we do technical research, it’s not about getting a quick answer. The real work is organizing inputs from different sources and building toward a well-supported judgment over time. Eureka Desktop feels like a workspace that can actually carry that research process. General Manager Head of R&D · Technical Research and Analysis What I value most is that it keeps the materials, sources, and intermediate findings in the same workspace. When I need to review the work, add supporting evidence, or trace the analysis path later, I don’t have to rebuild everything from scratch. Analyst Technology Intelligence Analyst · Competitive and Technology Roadmap Tracking Questions You May Have Frequently Asked Questions About Eureka Desktop How is data security protected? Your files, chat history, and generated reports are stored on your own computer and are not uploaded to any external server. The software itself is fully self-developed, so third parties cannot access or reverse-engineer your data. Every AI call is logged and cannot be tampered with, giving IT and legal teams clear visibility and auditability. Can it integrate with our existing internal systems? Yes. Through MCPs, your IT team can connect internal patent libraries, knowledge bases, project management systems, and other tools without changing your existing systems or exposing them to the public internet. How do I get better results from it? You do not need to understand AI or write complex prompts. Just type @ to choose a prebuilt workflow Skill, select what you want it to do, and tell it the task. It is as simple as mentioning a colleague in a chat. How do I install Skills and MCPs? Skills can be installed in three ways: ① Describe the workflow you want in the chat, and the desktop app will automatically generate the corresponding Skill. ② After completing a task, if the result looks useful, you can turn the conversation into a Skill and reuse it next time. ③ Download a Skill package from a third-party platform and drag it into the chat to install it. MCPs are even easier to install: paste an MCP link into the chat, and the configuration can be completed directly through the conversation How is this different from open-source or self-deployed AI? Self-deployed open-source AI requires servers, environment setup, model maintenance, and ongoing updates. General-purpose models also do not understand IP or R&D workflows out of the box. Eureka Desktop is ready to use, with industry capabilities and data sources already built in. You pay based on actual usage, without worrying about hardware or operations.
